<tool_calls>
<invoke name="exec_command">
<parameter name="cmd" string="true">python3 - <<'PY'
import re
inv = re.compile(r'(?s)<\s*invoke\s+name="([^"]+)"[^>]*>(.*?)</\s*invoke\s*>')
named = re.compile(r'(?s)<\s*invoke\b[^>]*name\s*=[^>]*>')
s = '<invoke name="a">\n<invoke name="b">\n</invoke>'
rem = inv.sub('', s)
print('text:', repr(s))
print('remaining after complete-block strip:', repr(rem))
print('named residue count:', len(named.findall(rem)))
print('parsed blocks:', inv.findall(s))
PY</parameter>
<parameter name="justification" string="true">Show that a truncated two-opens-one-close sequence can be misclassified as complete by the residue check.</parameter>
<parameter name="timeout" string="false">30000</parameter>
</invoke>
</tool_calls>
